data.analytical_role: neutral monoprotic HA;acetic-acid formula used only for ordinary mass accounting
fully dissociated sodium A salt;one Na+ and one acid moiety per formula unit

data.model: Closed ideal aqueous monoprotic acid/sodium-salt system with no CO2,other ions,precipitation or activity-coefficient corrections. Constant water activity,all volumes additive and inventory fractions exact. Ka and Kw are explicit adopted study constants,not new measurements.
data.counterfactual: To isolate the numerical role ofwater autoprotolysis,repeat the SAME mass/charge/speciation model with Kw=0 while keepingacid and sodium analytical inventories unchanged.
data.shortcut: Use pKa+log10(reference salt moles/reference neutral-acid moles),withanalytical inventory moles rather than equilibrium species concentrations;dilution multiplies both inventories equally.

provenance.kind: controlled computational analytical study, not experimental measurements
provenance.generation: Controlled computational input table for the stated study; not experimental measurements. Authentic source inputs are documented separately when present.
